open_points.subject: AuditEntry erasure across restore
open_points.text: the last number written is held in the instance marks outside the store, so a restore from an older backup does not lower it
open_points.question: When an older backup contains audit entries that were subsequently erased, does restoring it make those entries readable again, or must the instance marks preserve their erased lifecycle state?
options: Previously erased entries remain erased after restore
Entries present in the restored backup become readable again
open_points.default_guess: Previously erased entries remain erased after restore

open_points.subject: MigrationClosure representation after restore
open_points.text: also held in the instance marks outside the store, which a restore does not replace
open_points.question: Do the instance marks retain every MigrationClosure fact—success instant, acting principal, confirmation id and file digest—or only the fact that import is closed?

open_points.subject: Imported models and permanent closure after restore
open_points.text: absent, then present forever: a restore from an older backup does not lose it
open_points.question: If the restored backup predates the successful import, must the imported Projects, Customers, Rooms and ArtifactPointers also remain present, or may the MigrationClosure survive while those imported models disappear and another import remains refused?
options: Restore must preserve or recover both the closure and all imported models
The closure survives even if the imported models disappear
The closure is cleared when restoring to a state before the import
open_points.default_guess: Restore must preserve or recover both the closure and all imported models
